About

I'm a front-end developer based in Johannesburg, South Africa, working mostly in vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Every project on this page started as a way to understand one specific technique — a layout method, an animation, a browser API — well enough to reuse it.

I care about pages that load fast, work without JavaScript where they can, and hold up on a small screen and a slow connection.

  • HTML5
  • CSS3 / Flexbox / Grid
  • JavaScript (ES6+)
  • Responsive Design
  • Canvas & Web Audio
  • Git & GitHub
